description: Static checks (with a type check of web/assets/*.js and worker/mcp.js) and the MCP server's test; the build (scripts/build.mjs, which pages.yml runs to deploy), the dev server (scripts/serve.mjs), a preview of the build with the MCP server, and the deploy (wrangler, which pages.yml runs too); the MCP server's packages (worker/mcp.js, bundled by wrangler): pages work unbuilt, as they are in web/.

scripts.check: biome check && node scripts/translate.mjs --check && node scripts/translate.mjs .check && node scripts/countries.mjs .check --sample && html-validate 'web/*.html' '.check/*/*.html' && node scripts/types.mjs --check && node scripts/ski-style-check.mjs && tsc -b jsconfig.json --force && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --test worker/mcp.test.js && uvx ruff@0.17.3 check scripts ski-tiles && uvx ruff@0.17.3 format --check scripts ski-tiles
scripts.format: biome format --write && uvx ruff@0.17.3 format scripts ski-tiles
